g.text: Known five-order volume recombination: signed complex comparisons
Matched real/imaginary scales within each spectrum or volume pair. Markers overlay independent direct-sum estimates.
Nyquist imaginary values are order one by definition. Ridge biases the specimen case. Finite periodic model; no general physical recovery claim.
Inputs, exact Decimal arrays, errors, budgets and hashes are in the companion JSON. Figures are not numerical oracles.
